accept_if: fresh spot normal-CDF probability proxy > original first quote price

valuation.strike: exact ticker and expiry; greater_or_equal; custom_strike.floor_strike preferred
valuation.volatility: causal Hyperliquid five-minute realized volatility in bps

entry_deadline_semantics: Absolute first source quote created_ts +60s; no reset on reprice/side change; no forced cancel/flatten at deadline
feature_clock: at original source quote creation; poll-start timestamps require next distinct same-stream poll as receipt upper bound
publication_rule: Actual durable decision publication; kept source fills must follow individual quote publication plus0.5s and original order activation, before original expiry/cancellation
accounting_rule: Complete archived source ledger and compact official settlement must reconcile; identical retained entry inventory inherits all management and fees; no retained inventory zero; strict partial inventory unidentified
missing_data: Unclassified or pending; never treated as avoided loss or zero PnL
historical_selection_disclosure: Selected using data through2026-09-17T06:00:00Z; historical selection is not an untouched holdout; live publication requirements are stricter than historical replay
